Emotionally Tired

27 Jan 2023

Sometimes there are days that are just days, you know? Conversations are a little more weary, speaking becomes more effortful, and you’d like to just stop it all, get under the covers, and let tomorrow come already.

That’s where I’m at now.

I want tomorrow to be here.
